accessModel.method: nearest point from canonical plant anchor to public OSM highway geometry loaded by Campus GIS
accessModel.policy: The nearest OSM-road point is a spatial candidate for access analysis only. It must never be labelled as the real gate without authorised survey/CAD evidence.
